missing: A tested, direct pick among the sub-$900 2 kWh units that actually have a TT-30 RV outlet (Growatt INFINITY 2000 PRO, OUPES Mega 2 Pro, Dabbsson DBS2100 Pro, Renogy 2000, ALLPOWERS R2500 V2), with measured usable capacity and inverter efficiency, plus current sale prices and working discount codes.
why: No major reviewer or authority answers the exact question. OutdoorGearLab's lab-tested page is a general category guide that only mentions the Jackery 2000 v2 dipping under $900, with no RV-outlet or 2 kWh-under-$900 comparison; Car and Driver's roundup features an over-budget 2.7 kWh unit. Two niche sites (gearranking, outagereadyguide) answer with specs and checked prices but no verifiable testing, and the rest are brand product pages, an unreadable RV dealer page and a generic RV guide. This mirrors the proven-win pattern: a focused page comparing sub-$900 2 kWh stations with TT-30 outlets, current prices and tested codes would stand out, though OutdoorGearLab's brand will sit alongside it.
